$comment: CC_GAME_1 roster. Numbers are PERMANENT - never reused, never reassigned. Every model here was probed on this machine; probe_models.py is the source of truth.
scope: ONE goal only: distribute the assets, build the open world, drive a car in it, then test and watch.

probeEvidence.note: A model being listed in `opencode models` proves nothing. 9 of 13 candidates failed.

banned.$comment: Proven to demand money or a privacy opt-in. dispatch.py refuses these even if added to agents by mistake.
banned.rule: Zero-cost only. No exceptions, no approvals. Owner instruction, 2026-09-27.

1-big-pickle.name: Big Pickle
1-big-pickle.duty: يشخّص، يقرر، يصلح البنية، يشغّل التحقق، يحدّث README، يوزّع المهام

2-space-bunny.name: Space Bunny
2-space-bunny.duty: فيزياء السيارة، البثّ، الـmanifest، أي سكربت لعب

3-muse-spark.name: Muse Spark
3-muse-spark.role: المدقق — يراجع الأدوات والبناء قبل أن تُشغَّل
3-muse-spark.ownerConfirmedWorking: 2026-09-27 — صاحب المشروع شغّله من تطبيق OpenCode وردّ وتوقّف عند العقد بشكل صحيح.
3-muse-spark.cliTransport: FAIL. opencode-cli.exe returns: 'This Go model trains on request data. Allow paid endpoints that train on request data in your workspace's Privacy settings'. The desktop app sends the consent flag; the CLI does not.
3-muse-spark.howToRun: افتحه من تطبيق OpenCode على مجلد D:\CC_GAME_1 واسأله بذكاء. لا تشغّله عبر dispatch.py.
3-muse-spark.duty: يراجع أدوات بناء العالم قبل تشغيلها، ويوثّق الأخطار في docs/

4-ling-flash.name: Ling Flash
4-ling-flash.duty: يعدّ ما يجب توزيعه، يخطّط كم أين، يعدّل المانيفست، يعدّ لقطات المنظر. لا يكتب سكربتات.

5-longcat.name: Longcat
5-longcat.duty: يشغّل فحص الكمبايل، يفحص الـbuild، يتحقق أن السيارة تتحرك والعالم يُحمَّل. يرفض العمل إن فشل الفحص.

policy.noNewGameFeatures: Scope is asset distribution + open world + drivable car. Nothing else.
policy.lesson2026_09_27: A probe that fails through ONE transport does not mean the model is dead. opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3 fails from opencode-cli.exe (missing consent flag) but works in the desktop app. I blacklisted a working agent on CLI evidence alone. Test the way the owner actually runs the agent before declaring it dead.

cloudOpenClaw.$comment: Separate container. CANNOT see D:\CC_GAME_1. Never use it to edit project files.
